provenance: Original AI-generated shared abandoned-planet artwork for Orbit Imperium.

assets.crop: Complete centered sphere on transparent alpha; shared by every abandoned planet. Delivery adds the standard 6% transparent inset.

prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one reusable astronomical-atlas planet illustration for the dark navy galaxy map of the space strategy game Orbit Imperium, legible as a 40px thumbnail and as a larger image. Primary request: an abandoned planet, a desolate intact rocky world with dusty ash-gray continents, muted rust-brown scars, dry basins and faint traces of long-abandoned settlements. Style: premium realistic planetary render, finely textured but strong simple spherical silhouette. Composition: one complete centered sphere, square canvas, small transparent margin, no rings or surrounding objects. Lighting: upper-right cool neutral key light, readable stone-gray lit hemisphere, deep navy lower-left shadows, restrained pale rim. Mood: silent, deserted, exhausted; no active lights, no fiery explosion. Background: genuinely transparent alpha outside the sphere. No text, labels, UI, logos, stars, moons, ships, or watermarks.
